subject: Next steps & mutual action plan: Redwood pilot for Zenflow
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Mahmoud <aisha@zenflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Feb 2028 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Quick recap from today's call + proposed pilot milestones

Hi Aisha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap while it's fresh, and a proposed mutual action plan to keep momentum.

TL;DR
- Primary pain: inference latency and unpredictable per-token cost on current self-hosted stack; latency spikes during peak API traffic (particularly NER and reranking workloads).
- Goal: run a 6-week pilot to validate steady-state tail latency (95th pct) and per-token bill reduction targeting 30% cost savings vs current baseline.
- Decision criteria: SLA for 95th pct latency <= 220ms (for your 512-token median requests), cost/unit <= target, and compliance review passed.

What we heard (pain & impact)
- CTAs and support flows currently slow down during spikes; engineering spends 2–3 FTEs tuning inference routing.
- Data residency requirement for EU customers (later phase) but pilot can run in Redwood-hosted US region with sanitized traffic.
- Procurement: procurement team wants a clear timeline and a single contact for SOW/PO processing.

Proposed mutual action plan (draft milestones)
1) Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + access: Redwood provides sandbox API key and short checklist. Target: 2028-02-09 (contact: Mark Rivera).
2) Week 1–2: Ingest sample traffic & baseline run (we'll mirror ~72 hours of production traffic). Objective: measure 95th/99th pct latency.
3) Week 3–4: Tuning & validation — experiment with batching and quantization settings. Objective: meet latency/cost targets.
4) Week 5–6: Exec demo + procurement sign-off; deliver final report and recommended production configuration.

Owners
- Zenflow: Aisha (product lead), Mark (procurement)
- Redwood: me (soojin@redwood.com) — technical lead, Ben Carter (bench & commercial) for contract/discount approvals.

Open questions / asks from Redwood
- Can you share a short list of 3 representative endpoints and typical token lengths?
- Is a one-time redacted sample of traffic possible for baseline mirroring?
- Procurement timeline & PO owner (name/email).

I've attached a one-page MAP (Zenflow_MAP_v1.xlsx) and my post-call notes (soojin_postcall_notes.pdf) — feel free to share with procurement.

Next steps
- If the milestones look good, I'll send an updated MAP with firm dates and a draft SOW for review by EOD tomorrow.
- Proposed kickoff: 2028-02-09 at 09:00 PT.

Thanks — really excited to move this forward.

—
Sooj in Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Sooj in — thanks for the clear summary. This aligns with our notes. A few clarifications and confirmations: 

1) Endpoints & token lengths:
   - /ner (avg 160 tokens)
   - /classify (avg 48 tokens)
   - /rerank (avg 420 tokens)
We can export a redacted sample of 48 hours of traffic; I'll have Mark drop that into the shared location by EOD Wednesday.

2) Procurement timeline:
   - We need a 2-week internal review for SOW, so ideally have the SOW by 2028-02-10. PO owner is Mark Rivera (m.rivera@zenflow.ai).

3) Compliance note:
   - We'll need a short security questionnaire (SOC2 + data handling). Can your security team send the questionnaire or the SOC2 report link? Mark, looping procurement here.

Kickoff time works for a first pass — 2028-02-09 09:00 PT. Please confirm dial-in and meeting owner.

One more small ask: procurement will want to see an estimated pilot cost and any discounts. Ben — can you provide a pilot estimate we can share with Zenflow procurement?

Thanks — Aisha

--
Aisha Mahmoud
Head of Product, Zenflow

- Baseline run: 2028-02-10 to 2028-02-12
- Tuning & validation: 2028-02-13 to 2028-02-26
- Final report & exec demo: 2028-03-01

On the pilot estimate — Ben, do you have a ballpark we can share with procurement? If helpful, I can include a note that an approved PO will trigger a 15% pilot discount for the 6-week run.

Best,

Brief — approved: you can share the pilot estimate with procurement including a 15% pilot discount tied to an approved PO within 30 days post-demo. Please include the following in the SOW: 
- Pilot scope (6 weeks), deliverables (latency report, cost comparison, recommended config).
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency <= 220ms AND cost/unit reduction >= 25%.
- Billing: invoiced at pilot start (net 30).

Sooj in — I'll be available on the kickoff if you want commercial present. Also ok to waive setup fees for this pilot to reduce friction.
